ApocAir.Cockpit.controls: W / S  throttle up / down (stays set)|E / Q  stick forward / back|Left / Right arrows  stick left / right|O  mouse stick on / off (cursor up = forward)|V  stabiliser on / off|A / D  rudder and nose wheel|Space  wheel brakes|H  shove a blade by hand (up to about 120 rpm), then taxi with the stick back|F  (at the side)  get out
